answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a signal tag. The timber cap is enforced at intake and violet shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. A farm of 64 pays that 191 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
